notes.title: Notice of cessation of development and publication
notes.content: [p]Thank you for your continued patronage. We regret to inform you that we will be discontinuing service for this game on **Tuesday, October 21st, 2025**. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who has used the game so far, and we deeply apologize for the sudden announcement. We hope you will enjoy the game until the end, even though there is only a short time left. We look forward to your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: March Update
notes.content:
It's been a while, but development continues to go smoothly.
We have made an update now that we have reached a break in the development!
Enhanced UI
Added animations to menus, windows, and buttons

Adjustment of camera
The camera now moves smoothly. Enemy is zoomed in on bosses.

Item collect
When an item is picked up, it is registered as a collect! The status of the item will increase as the collect rate increases!
You can check the acquisition rate of all items from the drop information in the menu.

Addition of drop information
Rare items from enemies can now be checked.
The distribution of rare items is still being adjusted.

Level Skills
Skills can be obtained at levels 20, 40, 60, and 80.
Please use them as they are very powerful!


Addition of Enemy Abnormalities
All enemies are now affected by abnormal conditions.
Use spells and alchemies with their weak points to cause them to be affected!



Vol. 1 "No. 20: Ranbu - Isolated Island 2" is now available!
As the Enemy's level increases, not only its status but also its speed will increase!
Use weapons with ranged attacks in difficult quests, as there will be many enemies!

All of Vol2 is under adjustment!

notes.title: 7月アップデート！
notes.content:
いつもプレイしただきありがとうございます。2か月ぶりにアプデしました。

・DLCを販売しました

定価800円で1か月間30％オフで560円です！。

将来的に出るスマホ版へパック購入情報と、セーブデータを引き継げます。

是非購入してもらえると嬉しいです！

パックの内容はこの先のアプデでどんどん追加していく予定です。特にスキンはどんどん追加します。

・スタンダートパックの内容

１．広告を自動で削除（スマホ版は画面上部にバナー広告が出ますが、パック購入後自動でなくなります）

広告を見ることで、ブーストとアイテムの取得ができますが、広告を見ずにすぐに取得できます

上記はスマホ版の話です。

PC版では広告を見ることができないため、バナー広告は表示されず、ブーストとアイテムの取得ができません。

パック購入後は、ブーストのアイテム取得を選択するだけで取得できます（PC版も取得できます！）

２．倉庫を利用できるようになります

シティのショップエリアにいる人から利用できるようになります。アイテムを預けるようになるほか、別のキャラクターからアイテムを移動できるようになります。

３．装備の強化の幅が広がります

装備を20まで強化できます（通常は15まで）、特殊能力を5個目まで追加できるようになります（通常は4個目まで）

４．スキン（見た目）を変更できるようになります

シティにいる人から変更できます（通常は変更できません）

５．追加クエストを受注できます

今後実装される追加クエストを受注できます。

６．レアドロップ倍率と経験値の取得倍率が2倍になります

広告のブースト合わせたら6倍になります！

７．最大レベルが解放されます

PC版は最大レベル20、スマホ版は60です

スタンダートパックでは最大（現在99レベル）まで解放されます

８．キャラクターの作成できる数が増加します

スタンダートパックでは8体まで作成できます

９．クラスのパラディンとアルケミストを選択できるようになります

・レア武器を追加しました

レア装備がドロップするようになりました。見た目がすべてユニークなので楽しめると思います。

・スペル・アルケミーを調整しました

スペルとアルケミーを本実装しました。アイコンがすべて整ったと思います。

スペル・アルケミーのレベルが高いとエフェクトが追加されます（大体レベル10と20ごとです）

アルケミーは発明時にエフェクトが追加され、性能が変化します

また、レベルが高いと一部性能がアップするのもあります。

アルケミーはエネミーからドロップするスペルスクロール、アルケミーは使用回数でレベルがアップします

・ログインボーナスを追加しました

タイトル画面で表示されます（自動で追加されます）

曜日によってエネミーのドロップ率が増加します（月＝炎属性、火＝雷属性、水＝氷属性、木＝光属性、金曜＝闇属性、土日＝全属性）

・UIを調整しました

・基礎ステータスを割り振れるようになりました

レベルアップ時に取得する基礎アップポイントとヒューズマテリアルを消費して基礎パラメータをアップできます！

メニューのステータスから割り振れます

・一部設定を追加しました

メニューの一番右の設定から選んでください

落ちてるお金と消費アイテムを自動で拾うはオススメです

・フレンド機能を実装しました

メニューのインフォフレンドからルーム内の人をフレンドにできます

フレンドはルーム検索時に緑色に表示され、フレンドボタンからはフレンドのルームの一覧が表示できます

また、フレンド登録人数の1人につき0.01％レアドロップ率がアップします（最大フレンド数30人）

・クエスト難易度を調整しました

notes.title: February Update!
notes.content:
Here's the February update (belatedly)

The main storyline has been added. It is the yellow box that falls on the field.
In case you are interested, the story continues from the person in the control room in the City, to the forest dungeon, to the control room in the City, to the ruins.... The story will be supplemented by NPCs at the bar and other places in the future.
We want to allow people to play freely, so we do not plan to make it so that people are forced to read the basic story.

You can now play up to the boss in the factory dungeon. We are also adding the storyline to that point.

When on the room creation screen, you can now narrow down your search.

Changed the code skills. The code skills are now automatically activated when the EX Gauge is reached. The amount of EX gauge required for activation is different for each code.
Skill Effects
Apricot Oren: Increased speed of normal attacks
Celeste Blue: Distance attenuation of hit rate nullified & hit rate increased
Orchid yellow: Improved recovery from abnormal conditions & increased avoidance of abnormal conditions
Cardinal Red: Disables attacks at a certain rate
Parrot green: replenishes consumable items
Cosmo Pink: Increases spell level by 5 & reduces TP consumption
Shadow Purple: Low probability of abnormalizing the opponent when attacking
Multi-White: Increased power when attacking with weak attribute

notes.title: January Update!
notes.content:
We have added more weapons and weapon categories, mainly.
Some of them existed before the update, but here are all the weapon categories.
Saber type
Short range single attack, initial equipment for paladins
Sword
Close range attack, initial equipment for Soldiers.
Spear type
Close range attack, slightly faster and longer than sword
Dagger
Short-range multiple attacks, currently unavailable as a rare item
Twin Blades
Multiple attacks at close range
Double Saber
Short-range multiple attacks, slightly more powerful than daggers and twin blades, initial equipment for knights
Rapier type
Single attack, moves forward significantly when attacking. Fast attack speed.
Katana
Single attack, additional attack when HP is maximum.
Knuckle type
A single attack.
Handguns
Long range attack, can be equipped for all classes, initial equipment for all characters
Rifle type
Longer range than handguns.
Long-range rifle type
Long-range rifles have the longest range (lock-on range only in front), and are always on foot while equipped.
Shotguns
High power at close range, Enemy knockback is large.
Dual Barrettes
Continuous attack
Arrows
Long distance range attack
Crossbow type
Penetrating long-range attack, much smaller range than arrows
Launcher type
When the bullet hits the target, a blast is generated and it attacks at range.
Miniguns
It's a minigun, but the one we're making is a flamethrower (the weapon in the image), and it's currently unavailable because it's a rare item.
Wand
Increases mental power when equipped.
Magic Book
Magic book type: TP is restored when you hit the target.

Common equipment for non-rare weapons has been added.
Example: Handgun -> Ray Gun -> Luminous Handgun -> Break Ray Gun -> Force Handgun -> Nemesis Ray Gun -> Aegis Handgun -> Omega Handgun
Luminous -> Force -> Aegis are all common weapons, but only some of the other version weapons (Ray Gun for handguns) are present.
Equipment drops depend on your level, so at the current level cap of 30, you'll only get up to Luminous or Force.

Added armor and EXslot equipment (memory).

notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
This update is quite buggy. I'm so sorry.
We'll update again in January, so we hope you'll give it a long look.
Update details
Changed the class name, changed the appearance when creating a class.
This will probably stay the same until the official version.
Knight: Short range class. Can use some spells.
Soldier: Short range class. Cannot use spells. Can use special skills instead (not implemented yet).
Archer: Long-ranged class. Can use arrows and other long range attacks. Can also use some spells.
Shooter: Long-range class. Cannot use long range attacks. You can equip a special shield called the Sentry Shield. The Sentry Shield will automatically attack and chase you.
Mage: A magic class. She is good at attacking with spells, and will attack with her opponent's weak attributes. They also have the ability to apply abnormalities to enemies, though the probability is low.
Paladin: A short-range and magic class. They can use some short-range weapons and many spells, though the number of times they can use them is limited.
Alchemist: A long range and magical class. They attack with long range weapons and use alchemy (the spell version of alchemist) to inflict abnormalities on the enemy.

Item details are now displayed by simply hovering the cursor over them. You can check the details when you open your inventory.
Enemies can now be inflicted with abnormalities (only forest monsters have been implemented).
Added alchemy (like spells) with the implementation of Alchemist. The alchemy can be activated by consuming fire, wind, ice, or earth ether. Alchemy can be used without motion like other costly items. Compared to spells used by mages and the like, it has a higher chance of putting enemies in an abnormal state.

Added the concept of money and (in M) weapon shops. Weapons shops can be found in the store area of the city, and can be purchased from the person with the white textures (it's buggy...).

notes.title: November Update!
notes.content:
Update for November!
Controller support has been added (XBOX360 only for now).
We're planning to add support for DualShock 4 and XBOXONE in December.
Controls: Left Stick Move
Left shoulder Switch slots (to switch between selected items in inventory, etc.).
Button above the left trigger Moves the viewpoint forward.
Right stick Viewpoint control
Right button up Strong attack
Right button left Weak attack
Right button down Cancel (used when menu is open)
Right button Right button Right button Right button Right button Right button Right button Right button Right button Right button Right button Right button Right button
Right trigger down Switch main menu
START button Opens the menu.
BACK button Toggles the information in the item details window in the inventory.
Some operations are not yet implemented. The first start screen and so on do not work.

Enemies will now drop items.
You can now change your appearance (skin). There is an NPC in the city square that allows you to change your skin.
The UI for changing the skin is a little bad, so we'll change it soon.

Armor has been implemented. You can equip it by going to Menu -> Items and putting the item in the left column.

The city has been expanded. Added a fashion area and a tavern. There's nothing there now, but we'll add more stuff later.

Spelling has been added & adjusted.

The English dubbing will be done after the story has been implemented to some extent.
Thank you for your patience.
